My Incineroar is at full HP with a sitrus berry, facing a Rotom-Wash at 64% carrying Life Orb, with its attack dropped and special attack boosted. Parting Shot isn't viable since Incineroar is my only remaining Pokémon, so switching out isn't an option. That leaves Flare Blitz or Protect as my realistic choices, and I'm estimating whether Flare Blitz's reduced effectiveness still does meaningful damage given Rotom's current HP and defensive stats.

Since Rotom-Wash outspeeds Incineroar, it'll strike first regardless of what I choose, and a boosted Hydro Pump could threaten a serious chunk of my health or even a KO, so I need to weigh whether Protect buys me anything useful here.

Even if I Protect this turn, Rotom still outpaces me next turn and two Flare Blitzes won't be needed if Rotom lands a big hit first—so Protect only buys a turn while costing Rotom some Life Orb recoil regardless of whether it actually connects.

Also, protecting repeatedly lowers success odds each consecutive use, so I can't spam it forever. Still, Protect now is the safer play since Rotom might just keep attacking or switch, and I'd rather not risk eating a hit unprotected this turn. I'll go with Protect.

Running the numbers, Flare Blitz with STAB would land for roughly 53 damage against Rotom's ~90 HP, not enough to knock it out, and the recoil would hurt. If I Protect instead, Rotom's boosted Hydro Pump could hit Incineroar hard, maybe close to half its health, but Protect used back-to-back risks failing. Parting shot without a teammate to switch into would also likely fail or just apply the stat drop without a swap.

Recoil only applies to my own attacks, so next turn Rotom could hit back with Hydro Pump while Incineroar might survive on Sitrus Berry. If Incineroar keeps using Flare Blitz, I'd be taking roughly 33% recoil per hit while whittling down its 202 HP.

Since Rotom outpaces me, it attacks first each turn, so Protect only buys a safe turn without progressing the fight -- and Life Orb recoil for Rotom only triggers if its hit actually connects.

With Protect used twice already, a third consecutive use would only succeed about 1 in 9 times, so relying on it again is basically a coinflip against disaster. That makes Protect not worth it this turn, pushing me toward either Flare Blitz for damage or Parting Shot to chip Rotom's Special Attack down and soften the incoming Hydro Pump.

With Disguise busted, Mimikyu sits at 88% HP with its Atk boosted to 156. I'm checking Incineroar's matchup here—103/202 HP, 110 Def, and since Incineroar is Fire/Dark, Mimikyu's Play Rough at 90 BP doesn't get a type advantage against it.

Actually Fairy is super effective against Dark, so Play Rough hits Incineroar for 2x, which with Mimikyu's boosted Atk could deal serious damage, potentially over 100 to its 103 HP. Going the other way, Incineroar's Flare Blitz against Mimikyu's Ghost/Fairy typing is just neutral damage, so I'm working out the exact damage formula using Incineroar's 183 Atk, 120 BP with STAB, against Mimikyu's defense to see how much of its remaining 88% HP it would lose.

Crunching the numbers, Flare Blitz could deal around 111-131 damage to Mimikyu's roughly 128 remaining HP, so it's a plausible KO.
